channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dennis Schroder | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dennis Schroder from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sean Marks on Dennis Schroder
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Sean Marks on Dennis Schroder trade:

“The ultimate goal is long term sustainable success. So we're weighing a lot of factors in here. It's never easy to see one of your own leave; but at the same time looking at the big picture here this is what's best for our organization long term.”

Sean Marks on Dennis Schroder, Dec 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Dennis Schroder
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on what he's seen from Dennis Schroder as a leader:

“That’s who he is... He does it in his own way, and he’ll let you know it, and I like it... It’s important because when we go back to: Who do we want to be and how do we want to do it? How do we represent the Brooklyn grit and The Brooklyn Way? Dennis can definitely help us with that part with his toughness, with the way he competes... All his teammates see it, so that’s part of leadership. Walking the walk instead of talking the talk.”

Jordi Fernandez on Dennis Schroder, Oct 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Dennis Schroder
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on the Nets’ starting point guard battle between Dennis Schroder and Ben Simmons:

“I want to be put in a tough spot. These are two really good players. They both want to start, and that's what I want. I want to create healthy competition within the group, and then from there, make me decide... If they don't meet expectations, they won't be the starting point guard.”

Jordi Fernandez on Ben Simmons, Dennis Schroder, Oct 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.
